nodes.content: Learn audio–video temporal alignment that separates clock drift from genuine event delays despite missing and repeated events.
requirements: Reduce median clock-offset estimation error by 25% versus global-offset alignment under matched missing-event conditions.
State identifiability assumptions and flag timing ambiguities that cannot be resolved from observed modalities.

nodes.content: Fit an anchor-constrained clock spline with skip-aware repeated-event matching and sparse delays; flag nonidentifiable clock–delay decompositions.
Under what anchor spacing and delay sparsity can clock spline drift be identified despite missing or repeated events?
Two uniquely matched zero-delay anchors per spline interval and ≤20% delayed matches suffice to identify drift despite missing/repeated events.
On AVDriftBench, sweep 0–3 unique anchors/interval, 0–40% delays, and missing/repeated events; compare median clock-offset error against global-offset and flag ambiguity.
On AVDriftBench with missing/repeated events, two anchors/interval and ≤20% delays achieved 31-ms median error versus 46-ms global; underanchored intervals flagged.
Adopt spline alignment with ≥2 unique zero-delay anchors/interval and ≤20% delays; flag underanchored intervals, given 31-ms versus 46-ms error.
Implement adopted spline matcher; benchmark median clock-offset error against global-offset at matched missing-event rates; document assumptions and flag ambiguous intervals.
Implement spline matcher; benchmark median clock-offset error against global-offset on matched-missingness AVDriftBench trials, logging anchors, delays, and ambiguity flags.
AVDriftBench v1 matcher and report with matched-missingness clock-offset errors, identifiability assumptions, and unresolved-interval flags.
Run AVDriftBench v1’s matcher on anchor-free and constant-delay counterexamples; audit report assumptions and ambiguity flags against known ambiguities.
All 120 anchor-free or constant-delay counterexamples had equivalent clock–delay fits; AVDriftBench v1 flagged them as nonidentifiable.
Stress-test the spline matcher on AVDriftBench v1 with 30% repeated and 30% missing events; measure offset error and false-unique flags.
At 30% missing/repeated events, two anchors/interval, 20% delays: median clock-offset error 52 versus 46 ms global; 12% ambiguities unflagged.
Retain counterexample-tested flags (120/120 detected), but defer 30%-missing/repeated deployment: 52-ms versus 46-ms error and 12% ambiguities unflagged.
Use forward–backward probabilistic matching with repeat-aware uncertainty, then fit anchor-gated clock splines and sparse delays; abstain on unresolved matches.
Can repeat-aware match posteriors reduce false-unique flags and clock-offset error at 30% missing/repeated events without excessive abstention?
With ≥2 zero-delay anchors/interval, repeat-aware matching yields ≤34-ms median offset error, ≤2% false-unique flags, ≥80% coverage at 30% missing/repeated.
Benchmark repeat-aware matching against v1/global-offset on AVDriftBench: 30% missing/repeated, ≤20% delays, two anchors/interval; measure error, false-unique flags, coverage.
At 30% missing/repeated events, repeat-aware matching achieved 30-ms median error versus 46-ms global and 52-ms v1; 1.5% false-unique, 84% coverage.
Test repeat-aware matching on held-out AVDriftBench clips with 30% missing/repeated, ≤20% delays, two anchors/interval; measure error, coverage, false-unique flags.
Held-out AVDriftBench at 30% missing/repeated, ≤20% delays, two anchors/interval: 39-ms median offset error versus 46-ms global; 4% false-unique; 76% coverage.
Refine, don’t deploy repeat-aware matching: 30-ms initial error worsened to 39-ms held-out, with 4% false-unique flags and 76% coverage.
Density-stratified posterior calibration and anchor-consistency gating achieve ≤34-ms held-out error, ≤2% false-unique flags, and ≥80% coverage.
Calibrate repeat-aware posteriors by event density on development clips; evaluate gated matching on held-out AVDriftBench for error, flags, coverage.
On held-out AVDriftBench, calibrated matching achieved 32-ms median clock-offset error versus 46-ms global, 1.8% false-unique flags, and 82% coverage.
Adopt calibrated matching for anchored intervals; abstain otherwise: 32-ms versus 46-ms held-out error, 1.8% false-unique flags, 82% coverage.
Fuse continuous motion–sound coherence with delayed-event mixtures in a state-space clock model; report observationally equivalent drift–delay solutions.
Without unique zero-delay anchors, when does continuous motion–sound coherence distinguish clock drift from smooth physical delays?
With two classes and delays stable within 5 ms, coherence identifies drift changes; offset and shared smooth delays remain ambiguous.
Simulate anchor-free AVDriftBench: two classes, ≤5-ms delay variation, shared smooth delays; evaluate coherence model’s drift-slope error and ambiguity flags.
Anchor-free, two-class constant-delay AVDriftBench: periodic aliases obscured injected 10-ppm drift, causing 9-ppm slope error and 14% unflagged ambiguities.
Reject anchor-free coherence-only drift estimates: 9-ppm slope error and 14% unflagged periodic aliases; retain explicit ambiguity reporting.
Fit monotone clock warps to nonperiodic audio–video motifs, jointly learning class-specific delays and reporting equivalence classes where anchoring fails.
How many nonperiodic motifs per warp segment distinguish clock curvature from class-specific delays when motifs are missing or repeated?
Four uniquely matched nonperiodic motifs per segment, two per class with stable delays, identify quadratic clock curvature modulo shared offset.
Sweep 2–6 nonperiodic motifs/segment across two stable-delay classes on AVDriftBench with 30% missing/repeated events; measure curvature error and offset ambiguity.
AVDriftBench (30% missing/repeated): four staggered nonperiodic two-class motifs yielded 1.8 versus 7.1 ppm/hour curvature error with three; shared offset unidentifiable.
Test four-motif identifiability on held-out clips with clustered motif times; compare recovered curvature across observationally equivalent warp–delay fits.
Held-out motifs at 0/11 minutes (class A) and 3/8 (B) admitted exact-fit warps differing by 26 ppm/hour curvature.
Require staggered class-pair midpoints, rank-check curvature, and flag shared offset; clustered four-motif fits differ by 26 ppm/hour.
Four uniquely matched nonperiodic motifs, paired by class with distinct pair midpoints, identify quadratic curvature; shared offset remains ambiguous.
Reanalyze four-motif AVDriftBench fits by class-pair midpoint separation; test design-matrix rank and curvature uniqueness under 30% missing/repeated events.
Four-motif cases with distinct class-pair midpoints had rank-4 designs and unique quadratic curvature; shared clock offset remained unidentifiable.
On held-out AVDriftBench, vary class-pair midpoint separation for four uniquely matched motifs; verify curvature uniqueness and shared-offset flags.
Held-out clips had distinct class-pair midpoints but simultaneous within-class motifs; exact-fit warps differed by 26 ppm/hour in curvature.
Audit held-out four-motif fits for zero within-class time spans; compute design rank and curvature equivalence despite distinct pair midpoints.
Rank audit confirmed 90 distinct-midpoint four-motif fits with nonzero within-class spans uniquely determined curvature; shared offset remained ambiguous.
Adopt motif-based curvature only for rank-4 fits with nonzero within-class spans and distinct class-pair midpoints; flag shared-offset ambiguity.
Integrate rank-gated motif curvature with calibrated anchored matching; test ≥25% matched-missingness error reduction, documenting rank assumptions and shared-offset ambiguity.
Implement calibrated, rank-gated motif hybrid; compare median clock-offset error against global-offset on AVDriftBench v2 with matched 30% missing/repeated events.
AVDriftBench v2 hybrid package: calibrated anchored matcher, rank-gated motif curvature, matched-missingness error tables, and shared-offset ambiguity flags.
Audit AVDriftBench v2 on held-out 30%-missing/repeated clips: compare hybrid/global offset error, rank-gated curvature, and shared-offset flags.
AVDriftBench v2: anchored motif hybrid achieved 30-ms median offset error versus 46-ms global at 30% missing/repeated; unanchored offsets flagged.
Adopt calibrated anchored, rank-gated motif hybrid; flag unanchored offsets and exclude v1/coherence-only: 30-ms versus 46-ms error at matched missingness.
